about_the_game:
Discover the original soundtrack of Tirsy's Tale. This soothing soundtrack is comprised of several calming music tracks that are featured in the world of Reqweki throughout Tirsy's adventures. 22 tracks totalling around 2 hours worth of music in length. 

"We are proud to share our soundtrack with everyone! Hatchlings, it means a lot to know that you wanted to be able to download the whole soundtrack and wanted to show further support for Tirsy's Tale. So a special thanks from those of us at Rawr X3 to you all!"
